title: Hipparcos main catalogue: the 960 stars brighter than V = 4.55 that have a position and six fast-moving stars, positions (ICRS, epoch J1991.25) and proper motions
verdict_rule: Angles between the same stars that change with the observer's place or with the hour of the night, as lights on a dome a few thousand kilometres up would show.
license_note: The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues (ESA 1997), distributed by the CDS (VizieR I/239), free for scientific use with citation.

sources.cite: ESA, The Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200 (1997); VizieR I/239, table hip_main

units.ra, dec: deg, ICRS, epoch J1991.25, as published (fields H8, H9)
units.pmra: mas/yr, proper motion in right ascension times cos(dec) (H12)

inputs.origin: VizieR I/239 (Hipparcos main catalogue), Harvard mirror, the request in the URL; the file's header carries the request and its date.
VizieR I/239 (Hipparcos main catalogue), Harvard mirror, the request in the URL; the file's header carries the request and its date.

notes: Two of the 962 bright entries (HIP 55203 and 78727, close binaries) have no astrometric solution in the main catalogue and are left out. Nothing is computed by the build: the rows are copied as published, rounded to 1e-5 deg and 0.1 mas/yr. The page moves the stars itself (src/tabs/star/radec-logic.js): proper motion along a straight line with no radial velocity, precession as a rotation about the pole of the ecliptic. The two files are VizieR answers (Harvard mirror; the CDS server was down on the day), their headers carry the request and its date.
public_raw_why: CDS/VizieR distributes it free for scientific use with citation; its terms do not say that a copy may be republished, so only the hash and the request are given.
